steps.text: My dear sister.
Traveling with the gentleman has taught me that the lands beyond are very different from Dahuang. Humans have invented many new things in just a few decades.
There are all kinds of cities in Yan, more than just fields as far as the eye can see. There are glamorous palaces and busy markets, and so many more fascinating things.
I'm just coming back for a little break. Then I'll go out on a long journey again. I don't know how many years it will be.
Dahuang isn't the backwater hovel it once was. There are many people who can take care of these fields for you. Are you sure you don't want to go and see with me?
I realized that the world outside isn't so different from Dahuang after all.
How long has it been? Decades? Centuries? Perspectives change.
The more you see, the more you realize that people are the same everywhere. Devious, but predictable.
Yes. Now I fully understand what the gentleman said before he died.
Just how long do you plan to stay here, my dear sister?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wei—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Why do you still shut your self away like this? It took us so much effort to get you out of that hill. Shu's not here. Wanna go for a walk with me?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: There's nothing new here, but the produce is on another level compared the agricultural plates in the other cities. Say, have you seen how they make booze out of grain yet?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Did the Tianshi Bureaus come looking for trouble?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm not afraid of the Tianshi Bureaus!

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm just... I...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: With skills like that, you should be dealing with that big guy outside who refuses to move.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: All the Tianshis are out there for the relief effort. What can I do on my own? It's not like I could do it with my own two hands...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'm so bored! C'mon, lemme see what you're drawing...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, don't be like that. I could give you ideas, if you've got art block or whatever.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Get, out—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Why so nervous? Looks like you're hiding something.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: No I'm not. Something's just bothering me.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: The folks at the Tianshi Bureaus might be annoying, but they can't actually do anything about you. The imperial court has already given us a guarantee. The worst they could do is complain.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So you're bothered about... him.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I can feel his presence. He never hides. Are you sure you don't want to go and see him? We're family, after all.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wow, you really are cold... I heard how he always brought you the best paintings of the era whenever he passed by your hill. Don't pretend you didn't like them.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Things are different now.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: When was the last time you saw him?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I can't say I remember.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: His business got so big that he started getting warnings from the Sui Regulator. He pulled things back a little afterwards. He's been enjoying himself the last few years, sightseeing all over Yan.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But the Sui Regulator keeps a much tighter eye on him than it does us.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How do you know all that?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I had a peek in the Regulator's notebooks in the course of my dealings with them. The parts that weren't super-double classified, anyway.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: 'His business became so big'? I always remember him as that simple-minded boy following Shu around, with no eye for anything other than silkworms and mulberry.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: The last time I saw him was when he 'passed by', and I caught a glimpse through the painting.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: His eyes were clouded, repulsive, like—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: —like the stinky weiqi failure, I know.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: He was in Baizao the year our weiqi failure broke out. Who do you think Yan had its eyes on for the past few years while ignoring you and I?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You think they're in cahoots?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: No idea. I thought Ling and Dage were the only ones he got along with.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But he wouldn't have been able to call on people like he does now if the Sui Regulator made a decision like that, would he?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You know how comfortable he is in human skin. Every transaction in the books he submits every year to the Sui Regulator is perfectly above board. You couldn't find a flaw if you put them under a microscope.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: He's always the first to donate whenever a city is hit by Catastrophe. The Sui Regulator has to give him some respect on that point alone.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: You really think he did it out of the kindness of his heart?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: He's our brother. I won't badmouth him behind his back.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Yeah, riiiight.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Anyway, relationships like ours don't exist amongst humans. Brothers? Sisters? I...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You what?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Get out of here. Now, and no peeking!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Fine, fine. No need to get all violent and excitable.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Sibling ties in the worldly sense mean nothing to us, after all...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Maybe Yanese historians will invent a word to describe our relationship in a few hundred years or so... maybe.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But we would've thrown a few more family reunions if you could change that stubborn streak of yours.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'm not stubborn.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So, when are you going to show me the twelve scrolls in your study?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Go away!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yes, I know it's twelve. You kept the one for Sanjie, our third sister, even after she disappeared.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: —Have you figured out who the people depicted in the scrolls are? Or did you give up on that?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Unless... you haven't even started on your self-portrait?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Why are you so stubborn?
A rainstorm.
The dark clouds have dispersed, but the moisture in the air remains palpable.
Zuo Le watches He Sheng clench his teeth and press the switch on his apparatus.
A large vehicle, the likes of which he has never seen, rolls over the fields, trampling row after row of crops underneath.
Wind blows past dead, yellow leaves, making a sound like scornful laughter.
Disaster comes and goes as it pleases.
What can mortal men do before the will of Heaven?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All these crops have to be destroyed?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: It was my first ever test field. Maize. All soaked in Originium-polluted water. No other choice.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Restoring Originium-polluted soil is extremely difficult. The land is vast, but precious little of it is fit for farming.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Even the cob of the corn was sweet. I tried it when I first came to Dahuang. It was the best thing ever.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I wanted to grow it in the earth, so that everyone could taste the sweetness, feel the joy that I did when I tried it for the first time.
Only the bare earth is left once the engine rumbling passes.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Found you, Xiaohe!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: The farmers are arguing with the Tianshis after the engineers bulldozed a field. You need to come! Hurry!

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Folks, the disaster has left us with little supplies and even less time. We can't afford any delays.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The decision has already been made to abandon these farms. Please, let us pass through with our tools.

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: Abandon? You liar! The Tianshis who planted here told me two days ago that the crop research was at a crossroads.

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: Who gave you the authority to trample our fields with your trucks?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: 'Originium particle concentration in Plate D-4 soil samples exceed acceptable limits.' That means this field is polluted and no longer usable—

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: We've dealt with stuff like this every year! Who do you think you are, an outsider deciding that this field should be abandoned?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: These fields can't be moved. It's been polluted by natural disaster, and the higher-ups have made the decision to not save it...

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: This is already a bad year for the harvest! There's going to be a famine if we don't save the fields!

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: You've never seen thousands die of starvation, have you? All you people care about is your construction projects! You're not helping to save the fields, you're trampling them!

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: Dahuang belongs to us!

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You speak without wisdom.

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: No wisdom, huh?

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: I'll show you wisdom!

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You dare strike me?

steps.name: Angry Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Screw you, son of a...

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: I'll show you a son of a...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Hey, everybody, calm down!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Uncle Wang!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: These fields...

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: Just look! It's bad enough that the fields were ruined by Originium, now these people are running over it with their trucks!

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: All they talk about is ministers and reports. Minister who? We've never seen them!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We've not received any notice of these fields being abandoned.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I thought the decision had been made to prioritize saving the soil...?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You didn't hear? The construction supplies have arrived. The rebuilding of Dahuang resumed last night.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The cost of soil repairs has been re-assessed based on the latest damage reports.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The decision was made to prioritize construction on the core and abandon the outer agricultural plates... and make preparations to move the core city.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Has research on the source of the pollutant been completed? Why the hasty decision?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: This comes from Tianshi Bureaus... way up. You can ask up the chain yourself, if you don't believe it.
He Sheng turns around. The farmers stare blankly at the tread marks left on the fields.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: If the Tianshi Bureaus' instructions are to abandon the fields, we will comply.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: But these fields aren't just places of work; they're people's homes as well.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: If there hasn't been a formal notice of evacuation, please, move this equipment elsewhere, at least for now.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Fine. But it'll happen in the next few days.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Duoxie.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: I understand the hard work you folks put into farming this land, but things have changed.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: People were stuck to the earth before the nomadic cities. Today, though, most agriculture takes place in hydroponic facilities on mobile plates.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: To be frank, there's nothing special about this land.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You said you're studying Originium-resistant crops, but nothing's come of the research after all these years, has it?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I'm just not sure... if this is the only result, then there is no way to expand the application of the Wanqing 'the Ten Thousand Qing of Fertile Fields' project.

spans.text: I'm just not sure... if this is the only result, then there is no way to expand the application of the
'the Ten Thousand Qing of Fertile Fields' project.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: All these years, and nothing to show for it... not even a bud of hope.

steps.name: Angry Farmer
steps.text: They're gone. What did you say to them, Xiaohe?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Nothing special...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: ...I think we should get to cleaning up, Uncle Wang.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Big Buffalo? Big Buffalo! What are you doing, just standing there?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What are we gonna do? Listen to the Tianshis and move Dahuang away? Leave all these fields behind?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: We should go ask the Xiangzhang.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: ...Say something!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: She would be the first to know if anything was happening to Dahuang. If she isn't saying anything, that means it's out of her hands...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: And mine...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Why are you holding your head like that?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Maybe Shennong really was a celestial Xian...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Otherwise, how could she have carved out farmland in an environment like this?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Sure, Shennong was amazing, but it's amazing how people have taken care of the land.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shennong would be so mad if you give up this easily!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Whoa!
Grain Buds steps on something and hastily pulls her leg back. A figure rises from the swaying rice.

steps.name: Napping Man
steps.text: Aww, that was a good dream...

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: I dreamed of a bumper harvest, before a Catastrophe woke me up.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Why are you sleeping in the fields? Someone might step on you.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: You already stepped on me.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: That's because you're sleeping in the fields!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Apologies, sir. Are you okay?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: I'm not injured, but I've got a big muddy footprint on this fine fabric...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: It's your fault for not watching where you're sleeping!

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: You should watch where you're walking.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Grain Buds...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Well, what do you want me to do? Wash it for you? Buy a new set?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Ach, forget it. All my clothes are made of the finest stuff from all over the land. You wouldn't know how to wash it.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Are you the one who delivered the relief supplies?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Hey, you're awfully clever.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: I'm a trader who managed to make a few coins. I came back when I heard about the disaster that hit Dahuang. Got to do my part for my homeland, after all.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You're from Dahuang? Why were you sleeping in the fields, then? Don't you have a home here?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: It's been so long that I could hardly recognize the place. Lost my way... say, do you know where the shadow play theater is?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shadow play? What's that?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: A kind of play that uses shadows cast by cloth-shrouded lamps and straw figures.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Do you not watch shadow plays here any more?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I've never seen it...

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Hm... where do you celebrate the harvest now?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The great stage?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Just follow this path and turn left at the third tree. It's behind the Shennong Shrine.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Oh, the Shennong Shrine is still here. That's good to hear.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Thanks. You're the first one to point the way for me. Well, fate has determined that we would meet. Here, I have a wish for sale. Anything you like.
The man opens his hand to reveal a round stone that gives off a serene glow.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: A wish. For anything you desire.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: A wish?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I don't believe you. You're a trader, not some Xian. How could you make my wish come true?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: I may be a humble trader, but I'm a big enough deal that I buy and sell anything.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: But the opportunity to trade with me doesn't come to everyone.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: ...For real?
Grain Buds looks back at He Sheng behind her, thinks about it, and turns back to the man.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: (Hushed) I wish...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: (Hushed) I wish Dahuang could always be safe and peaceful, and the harvests always good.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Sure, I can sell you that wish. What will you pay me for it?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Grain Buds... this guy is kinda weird. We should go.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: There's no use trying to scam me. I don't have any valuables.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: It doesn't have to be valuable in terms of monetary value. I accept anything that you value and treasure.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Xiaohe! Can I play that song?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Song? What song?
Grain Buds pouts.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: You stupid buffalo!
Far away, a few fowlbeasts perch atop a stockbeast, picking bugs off its hide with their long beaks.
The stockbeast quietly munches on grass, while the fowlbeasts frolic atop, occasionally stretching their necks and chirping happily.
Grain Buds puts her flute to her lips.
The wind provides a gentle accompaniment.
Green hills, flowing water, moonlight on the river♪
Sway, sway, little boat, let the flowers bloom♪
Silent are the stars on high, the wandering seeds sprout♪
Far on a boat you go, rice flowers in the wind♪
Sway, sway, far away you go♪

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: A fine payment.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: The stone is yours. Your wish will come true.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: ...Hmph.
Grain Buds puts down the flute, glares at He Sheng, and runs away fuming.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: She looked angry. Why?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: She arranged it for me when I took my entrance exam three years ago.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: I remembered. She just put me on the spot...

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Ah. Such precious sentiment.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: What about you? Is there anything you would like to buy from me?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Thank you, but there's nothing I want in particular right now.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Or should I say, what I want can't be bought. I have to earn it on my own.

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: I could hear you out, if you'd like. There isn't much I can brag about, but I've been to more places than most, and so I sell more things than most.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You said you sell anything. Do you sell a future where nobody will starve?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: The more valuable the good, the higher the price. What price will you pay for your tremendous dream?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I've cleaned up the polluted crops, He Sheng. Anything else you need me to—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Well-Dressed Man
steps.text: I'm not sure why you're staring at me, young man. Have we met before?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Excuse me, sir, we need to talk.
